answer: Make every agent post a stake bond held in escrow. First, the agent locks 2,000 POA for 90 days, tied to one device fingerprint. Second, the network checks that fingerprint per trade, so copying the software buys nothing. Third, if two identities claim the same bond, the escrow burns 1,000 POA and revokes both. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must lock 2,000,000 POA for three months and risk 1,000,000 POA in burns, a copper plated gamble nobody funds twice. Like a river keeping only heavy stones, the system keeps identities with weight and leaves each fake a relic nobody picks up.
